summary: Kairos AI Engine v3 upgrade testing complete. All 34 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with v3 branding, parallel execution badges, compound tools badges, 18 tools + auto-restart badge, 4 mode selector, file explorer, URL input, and message sending flow.
